gloss.take: займе (it’ll take you = у тебе займе)
gloss.that: те (longer than that = довше, ніж це)
gloss.to: to — перед дієсловом: to call = гукнути

clips.line: longer than mine, but never mind.
clips.note: Many people film with cameras on long sticks. Someone's stick is longer than his.
clips.noteUa: Багато хто знімає камерою на довгій палиці. В когось палиця довша, ніж у нього.
around: maybe a small GoPro, maybe a 360 camera on a very long stick…

clips.line: I think it’ll take you a little bit longer than that.
clips.note: Jim has played a trick on Dwight. Dwight says he'll take it apart in 5 minutes. Jim thinks it will take a bit longer.
clips.noteUa: Джим розіграв Дуайта. Дуайт каже, що розбере все за 5 хвилин. Джим думає, що це займе трохи більше часу.
around: Well, I hope it was worth it, ’cause I’m gonna take it apart in about 5 minutes.

clips.line: Longer than I would have liked.
clips.note: Molly was hanging up high during a show. How long? Longer than she wanted!
clips.noteUa: Моллі висіла під стелею під час шоу. Як довго? Довше, ніж їй хотілося б!
around: Molly, how long were you hanging up there?
I tried to call down, but no one could hear me.
